newsitem.title: CHINA: China becomes world's third biggest shipbuilder.
newsitem.headline: China becomes world's third biggest shipbuilder.

text.p: China has become the world's third biggest shipbuilder, with production hitting 1.9 million tonnes in 1996, the Economic Daily said on Wednesday.
The figure accounted for five percent of the world total, the newspaper said. Japan and South Korea are the world's top two shipbuilders.
China's production compared with 420,000 tonnes in 1982 when the country's mainstay shipbuilder, China State Shipbuilding Corp, was set up, the newspaper said.
The company's assets have soared to 50 billion yuan ($6.0 billion) from 3.5 billion yuan initially, it said. Accumulated pre-tax profits totalled 8.0 billion yuan.
Local newspapers have said China exported $1.3 billion worth of ships in 1996, up 95 percent from 1995. China's ship export tonnage rocketed a year-on-year 130 percent in 1996 to 1.6 million tonnes.
